description.short: Create, validate, and update Microsoft Project schedules from requirements.
description.full:
PDS MPP Schedule Generator helps project managers, schedulers, and delivery teams turn agreed requirements into Microsoft Project (.mpp) schedules in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams. Describe the project title, start date, tasks, durations, dependencies, and any resources to include. The agent can use accessible OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, and Teams messages as planning context. When requirements are sufficient, it creates, validates, and commits a completed schedule; draft-only requests remain uncommitted. It can also update an existing plan when asked, using an authorized project session and changing only the requested items.

After a completed schedule is committed, its output card offers Download, OneDrive, or SharePoint delivery; choose the destination there. Cloud delivery requires permission to the selected location. A draft or preview is not a saved MPP, so open the delivered file to verify it. Custom calendar working times and holidays are not serialized into the output MPP and should not be assumed to have been applied.

You need Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams, a PDS connection, and permission to access any selected plan and OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, or Teams messages used as context. On first sign-in to PDS, an account is created automatically and you may be asked to consent. Teams sign-in alone does not sign you in to PDS. Search is limited to content your account can access. Usage is subject to account limits. Supported language: English. For help, visit https://projectdata.io/contact-us or email support@projectdata.io.
